en.title: The Hill of Promise: Beyond the Final Train
en.premise: The roar of modernization heralded the end of the samurai era. Makabe, a former master swordsman, discovers that his old comrade has ascended to a position of power in the new government and has boarded the 'Final Train,' the ultimate symbol of the changing times. Bound by a vow made amidst the fires of war—to reunite at the Hill of Promise—Makabe charges forward with a single blade in hand, cutting through the searing steam and clash of steel toward a fated duel.

zh.title: 约定之丘，在最终列车的尽头
zh.premise: 文明开化的咆哮，宣告了武士时代的终结。前剑客真壁得知，昔日的盟友已出任新政府要职，并登上了象征时代的“最终列车”。真壁心中始终铭记着曾在战火中许下的誓言——“定在约定之丘再次相会”。在蒸汽的热浪与钢铁的轰鸣交织之中，真壁手持一柄长刀，向着宿命的决斗奋力前行。
